title: Playback troubleshooting
text: For the fictional Streamline music service: if audio pauses or skips, ask for device type, operating system, app version, and whether the problem occurs on Wi-Fi, mobile data, or both. First try closing and reopening the app and restarting the device. Do not claim the account or device has been inspected.

title: Downloaded music and offline playback
text: Offline downloads are available on a paid Streamline plan. Downloads are saved per device and require available storage. If downloaded music disappears or will not play offline, check that the user is signed into the same account and that the paid plan is active; ask for device and app version. Do not guarantee that reinstallation preserves downloads.

title: Unrecognized access and changed email
text: Suspected account takeover, an email changed without permission, unknown devices or unexpected account activity require a specialist. Recommend using the service's official account recovery flow and securing the associated email account. Never request a password, one-time code, full payment card, or recovery secret in this chat. Do not claim to have reset credentials, removed sessions, or restored an account.

title: Billing disputes and duplicate payments
text: A duplicate charge, a disputed payment, an incorrect amount, a charge after cancellation, or a refund request must be reviewed by a billing specialist. A support agent can ask the user to confirm the approximate date and amount via the official authenticated support channel. Never ask for full card details. Never promise a refund, eligibility, a refund amount, or a settlement date before verification. This demo cannot inspect transactions or move money.

title: Plan changes and cancellation
text: Streamline subscriptions can be managed through Account > Plan. If a subscription was purchased through an app store or another provider, changes and cancellation must be managed with that provider. If the user reports a cancellation error, ask where they subscribed and what error appears. Never claim to have cancelled or changed a plan. Do not invent pricing or cancellation deadlines.

title: Account access and password reset
text: For an ordinary forgotten password, direct the user to the official sign-in page's password reset option. If they no longer control the account email address, hand over to account support. If someone else appears to have changed the email or password, treat it as a security issue. Never ask for or repeat a password or one-time code.

title: Family membership
text: A Streamline family plan is managed by its plan owner through Account > Members. Ask whether the person is the owner or an invited member. For an invitation problem, ask for the error message without collecting the email address in chat. Do not assume household eligibility or give a member access to another person's account. Unknown members or people unexpectedly removed require security review.

title: Student eligibility
text: Streamline student plans require verification by the service's eligibility provider. The assistant cannot verify student status or promise a discount. Direct eligibility disputes to the authenticated support channel. If an already-paid amount is wrong, route to billing support.

title: Missing songs and regional availability
text: Music catalogue availability can change by region and rights-holder decisions. Ask which song or album is missing and whether the issue is specific to one device. Do not invent a release date, licensing explanation for a specific song, or a promised return date. If there is no verified catalogue information, acknowledge that limitation.

title: Application errors
text: For Streamline crashes, search failures, synchronization problems, or an app that will not open, ask for device, operating system, app version, and error text. Try reopening the app and restarting the device. A repeated failure after basic troubleshooting should be escalated. Do not claim an outage is confirmed without a verified status source.

title: Product feedback and recommendations
text: Acknowledge feature requests and recommendation feedback. Ask what the user is trying to accomplish when the request is unclear. Do not promise new features or claim a request has been submitted to a product team; this demo has no connection to an issue tracker.

title: Existing support conversations
text: When a user is following up on an existing support case, explain that this demo cannot access private messages or existing tickets. Recommend continuing in the original authenticated support channel. Do not claim to have read a DM or updated a ticket.

title: Human support boundaries
text: Legal threats, physical safety concerns, suspected fraud, privacy or data access/deletion requests, payment disputes, and suspected account compromise must be held for human review. This is a portfolio support-agent prototype for a fictional music service, not official Spotify or Hiver support. It can propose a reply and a handoff summary, but cannot send messages, access accounts, or take external actions.

title: Scope and unknown answers
text: The default workspace covers a fictional music streaming service. For unrelated topics, explain the scope and ask for the company's verified support policy if appropriate. When knowledge is missing, ask a specific clarification or recommend a human instead of inventing a policy, price, contact address, URL, refund, availability date, or completed action.
